oxy.name: OxyGenix Atmospherics
oxy.desc: Owns 94% of all breathable air in the Settled Sprawl. The remaining 6% is under litigation.

halcyon.name: Halcyon Debt & Trust
halcyon.desc: The bank that froze you. Literally. Your cryo-pod is technically their property, and so, by extension, are you.

gristle.name: Gristle Nutrition Group
gristle.desc: Feeds forty billion workers with Protein Paste(tm). Ingredients are a trade secret, protected by orbital lasers.

paragon.name: Paragon Compliance Services
paragon.desc: Private police, private army, private judges. Bounty hunting is their most profitable franchise.

lumen.name: Lumen Omnimedia
lumen.desc: News, ads, entertainment and memory-implant jingles. If Lumen didn't report it, it didn't happen. If Lumen did report it, it happened louder.
